emit.description: Events published transactionally with the ops

orphaned_steps.description: Recorded hashes not encountered during this replay pass

allOf.title: done and continue_as_new must appear alone
allOf.description: Recording a step ends the pass, so a handler cannot both record a step and return. Ops alongside these mean a swallowed step result. `error` is deliberately absent: see PROTOCOL 5.2.2.

allOf.title: a retryable error must appear alone
allOf.description: Retrying re-executes; committing records what happened. One envelope cannot ask for both, so an SDK holding recorded ops and a retryable failure emits the ops alone and re-raises next attempt (PROTOCOL 5.2.2).

allOf.title: join is retired and refused rather than ignored
allOf.description: ADR-023. additionalProperties: false already rejects it; this names the field so a sender is not told the envelope was merely malformed (§11).
